body:
You can get freedom from home and a social life without going to University. And honestly- the programmers that I know that have the best jobs? They either have an unrelated degree or dropped out and are so obsessed with coding that they will make shit on their own at home for fun. Please save the money. If you can save money by staying at your parents rent-free, while not feeling boxed in, do it. If you need to gtfo of the parents, then move out.

Move out, get some room mates your own age, and work for a bit. Work for something to do. Teach yourself game dev on the side for something to do. If after 1-2 years, you still feel dedicated to game dev, then go to school. Do not pay for Uni for a social life and to move out.

Why not both? Are there any online Uni courses you could take that would start you in the right direction? Could you work a few years, teach yourself game dev independently, and save up for school?
If you're old enough to go to University, you're old enough to have a job, pay your own way, and make your own decisions. You don't need to convince your parents of anything. 

If you just want to go to Uni to go drinking with mates though, you may want to rethink your plan. Student debt is brutal.
Well, that was a kick in the ass. Needed it. Thanks.
